input.story: As a registered user, I want to manage my profile, change my password, set up two-factor authentication with an authenticator app, see and revoke my active sessions, link my Google or GitHub account, choose light or dark theme with auto-saving, upload an avatar up to 5 MB, and permanently delete my account, so that my account is accurate and secure.

output.summary: 3 to fix (2 high) · 1 unclear word · reads as several stories

problems.says: This story is really 7 features: Password, Two-factor, Sessions, OAuth, Preferences, Upload, Deletion
problems.fix: Split it into one story per feature, or accept that each part gets only a few tests.

problems.says: Nothing says what happens when it fails.
problems.fix: The story only describes the path where everything works. Say what the user sees when the input is invalid, the limit is reached or the save fails — that is the half the tests come from.

problems.says: “secure” is not something anyone can test.
problems.fix: Say the rule: “sent over HTTPS, never written to a log” instead.

ask_the_po: “secure”: what is the real number or rule here?
notes: Features found in the story: Password, Two-factor, Sessions, OAuth, Preferences, Upload, Deletion.
